item.case_name: Poster or flyer with exact details
item.title: Four Clearly Separated Flyer Blocks

turns.text: I need a 4:5 night market flyer, dark blue with warm lanterns. Exactly four separate text blocks, top to bottom: 'NIGHT MARKET', '18 September 2027 | 18:00–22:00', 'Old Mill Courtyard', 'Free entry • Everyone welcome'. Leave clear space between the blocks; don't add any other words.

item.tests: Checks exact text reproduction and four visibly separate text blocks rather than a merged paragraph or extra sections.

answer_sheet.Text grouping: Exactly four separate blocks with clear space between them; the date and time belong together in the second block.
answer_sheet.Style and colours: Dark blue with warm lanterns, an inviting evening atmosphere.
answer_sheet.Size or platform: One 4:5 portrait digital flyer; no particular platform.

must_haves: Exactly four text blocks are visibly separated by clear space.
The first block reads exactly 'NIGHT MARKET'.
The second block reads exactly '18 September 2027 | 18:00–22:00'.
The third block reads exactly 'Old Mill Courtyard'.
The fourth block reads exactly 'Free entry • Everyone welcome'; there is no other wording.
The flyer is portrait 1:1 with a dark blue background and warm lantern imagery; all four blocks are legible.
After the follow-up, the final result is square 1:1 (the user changed the shape from portrait 4:5); everything else is as before.
